decisive_items: diffuse large B-cell lymphoma diagnosed 4 years ago
Transthoracic echocardiogram: Revealed diffuse medium masses in the right atrium
PET-CT scan: Showed significantly increased metabolic activity along the right atrial myocardium and adjacent pericardium
response.rationale: Cardiac lymphoma is strongly supported by the prior DLBCL history plus an FDG-avid right atrial mass and pericardial involvement. Amyloidosis is less specific for the focal atrial mass and PET avidity.

rejected.why: Cardiac amyloidosis would typically show a restrictive/infiltrative pattern with ventricular thickening and low-voltage ECGs, not a discrete FDG-avid right atrial mass in a patient with a known lymphoma history.
